description: This Swift file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawKitResources' responsible for locating and providing access to a resource bundle for the OpenClawKit project. It includes methods to find the bundle inside different contexts such as app bundles, SwiftPM development environments, and tests, with fallback mechanisms to ensure resource accessibility without causing crashes.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used as a token for 'Bundle(for:)' to facilitate bundle lookup.

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Attempts to find and return the resource bundle for OpenClawKit by checking various locations, including inside the main bundle, via SwiftPM, or as a fallback default to 'Bundle.main'.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Safely attempts to locate the SwiftPM-generated module bundle by exploring several candidate URLs and directory structures to avoid runtime crashes.
